name: @hussmartinez/ai-core
description: Headless AI provider layer for the @hussmartinez family: Anthropic, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible adapters, a server handler and a browser transport. The family's only package with network code.

scripts.check:api: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.server.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.anthropic.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.gemini.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.openai-compatible.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.testing.json && hm-check-api-reports --main api/ai-core.api.md --types dist/index.d.ts api/ai-core-server.api.md api/ai-core-anthropic.api.md api/ai-core-gemini.api.md api/ai-core-openai-compatible.api.md api/ai-core-testing.api.md
scripts.api:update: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.json --local && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.server.json --local && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.anthropic.json --local && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.gemini.json --local && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.openai-compatible.json --local && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.testing.json --local && hm-check-api-reports --main api/ai-core.api.md --types dist/index.d.ts api/ai-core-server.api.md api/ai-core-anthropic.api.md api/ai-core-gemini.api.md api/ai-core-openai-compatible.api.md api/ai-core-testing.api.md
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:deps && pnpm check:single-copy && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:browser && pnpm build:examples && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm check:size && pnpm check:api && pnpm check:package
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint:deps && pnpm check:single-copy && pnpm check:api
